comment: Plants vs. Zombies GOTY. The launcher unpacks popcapgame1.exe into ProgramData and starts it. Upstream starts a thread that waits for that file, copies it next to the game as PlantsVsZombies_good.exe and kills the game so Steam starts it again. Here the copy happens at the start of the next launch instead, and replace_command then starts the copied exe in the same launch.
confidence: medium: the first launch still goes through the launcher; the second launch uses the copied exe.
notes: the copied exe is used from the launch after the launcher has unpacked popcapgame1.exe
